verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships its own background automation: workflows to automate processes, timed sequences, and AI agents. The prospecting agent watches accounts for buying signals and reaches out automatically, and smart deal progression handles next steps after calls. Some AI actions (post-meeting CRM updates and follow-up drafts) still require user approval, so autonomy is not complete. Missing for 10: detailed docs on workflow triggers, scheduling and actions; specifics on how agents are configured and run unattended; independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
